description: Consumer Affairs Authority - Order No. 32 Order made for the maximum retail prices of white suger & etc, which comes into effect from 19.03.2015 & rescind the order No. 31 published in Gaz. Ex. No. 1902/55 of 20.02.2015
reasoning: This gazette content is a legal/regulatory order issued by the Consumer Affairs Authority under Section 20(5) of the Consumer Affairs Authority Act, No. 09 of 2003. It establishes maximum retail prices for various consumer goods and rescinds a previous order. This falls under legal/regulatory matters as it constitutes subsidiary legislation and regulatory compliance requirements rather than government personnel or structural changes.
